comment: The declarative boru grammar — the single source both parser twins load (Go embeds this file; eng/ts reads it relatively). Tokens: fixed tokens carry their source text; matcher-produced tokens (no text) are minted by name and filled by the custom lex matchers. Edits: rule-spec amendments applied in order; each alternate is the tabnas AltSpec data (s: token-name sequences, p: push rule, r: replace rule, b: backtrack count) plus either a `text` shorthand (the action emits that unquoted Text marker as the node) or named `a`/`c` hooks bound from the host language's table. Registration order is load-bearing on both sides — do not reorder.

edits.comment: Value-open extensions: minilang literals, paren groups, XML literals, template strings, and the structural marker tokens the converter folds (design/XML-LITERAL.0.md par.3; ADR-012 rule 3).
Dot-chain continuation in map-pair-value position: fold the receiver plus the trailing `.`/`!.` chain into a paren group (see the dotchain rule).
